caption: The drawing depicts the entrance of a brick building with a light brown and red color scheme. There is a set of pale beige-grey stairs leading up to a door that is not visible in the image, with ornate green wrought iron railings and a newel post at the base of the steps. At the top of the stairs, two windows with dark green bars are visible, each adorned with overflowing flower boxes containing green, purple, pink, yellow, and white flowers. Below the windows, there is a metal gate painted green, providing access to a lower area beneath the stairs. In the foreground, two sections of intricate wrought iron fencing, also in green, enclose areas on either side of the stairs; the one on the right contains a shrub with green foliage and some yellow highlights. The ground is paved with beige and light brown tiles. Part of a leafy green tree branch extends into the scene from the upper right corner. The background features a plain wall of reddish-orange and beige bricks. The artist’s signature is in the lower right corner.
title: Balcony
